editionLabel: English Allplay edition, rulebook with 2025 copyright
location: Setup step 3 and Playing the Game, middle panels of the first PDF sheet
firstPlayerRule: The most smartly dressed player starts the first auction. The rules also allow choosing the first player at random.
officialTieBreak: Random selection is an official alternative; it is not restricted to a tie.
evidenceNotes: The source describes the criterion as most dapper. Copyright 2025 is visible on printed page 1 of the same PDF sheet.

editionLabel: English Allplay multiplayer rules, four-page publisher PDF
firstPlayerRule: Whoever saw a river most recently takes the first-player marker and starts.
evidenceNotes: The extracted text misnumbers this instruction as step 2; rendered page shows step 5. This is the multiplayer manual, not the separate solo rulebook.

editionLabel: English Allplay base-game rules, four-page publisher PDF
location: Setup step 4; Place Leaders and Game Turns
firstPlayerRule: The person who most recently drank water goes first.
clarifications: This player places the first caravan leader. Leader placement and subsequent turns proceed clockwise.

editionLabel: English Allplay rules, two-sheet publisher PDF
firstPlayerRule: The player who saw a panda most recently starts. Seeing one in a picture or video counts.
clarifications: This selects the first player for the opening round.

editionLabel: English rules linked by Allplay, four-page publisher PDF
firstPlayerRule: Whoever fed an animal most recently starts and takes the Turn Tracker and Turn Marker.

editionLabel: English Allplay rules, publisher file labeled v18
location: Preparation, below the Player Count Adjustments table
firstPlayerRule: The person who most recently watered a plant takes the first turn.

editionLabel: English Allplay rules, four-page publisher PDF
firstPlayerRule: Whoever went hiking most recently goes first.

editionLabel: English Journeys rules linked by Allplay
location: Setup; Roll Dice and Explore the Landmark
firstPlayerRule: The player who most recently took a trip is the first active player and rolls the exploration dice. Everyone fills in their boards simultaneously using the rolled numbers.
clarifications: The starting rule chooses the initial dice roller; it does not give that person an exclusive board-filling turn.
evidenceNotes: The current Allplay asset and the older Shopify v15 file both identify Journeys, with the same starting instruction. They have different file hashes; only the inspected current Allplay asset is cited here, and the second download is not counted as another edition.

editionLabel: English Allplay rules, four-page publisher PDF
location: Setup final sentence and Tricks opening instruction
firstPlayerRule: The player who most recently ate a piece of pie leads the first trick.
clarifications: Later card-selection order is determined by the cards played into each trick.

editionLabel: English rules linked by Allplay, publisher file labeled 2019 EN
firstPlayerRule: Whoever visited a bank most recently is the first auctioneer and takes the First Auctioneer Token.
clarifications: That person keeps this token for the game to mark the start of each round.

editionLabel: English Allplay rules, four-page publisher PDF
firstPlayerRule: The person most afraid of clowns becomes the first auctioneer.
clarifications: The auctioneer selects an attraction to auction and makes the opening bid or passes.
This is Allplay's circus auction game. Gamewright's Big Top is a different animal-and-color recognition game.

editionLabel: English rules linked by Allplay, four-page publisher PDF
location: Setup step 6; Offer Contracts opening paragraph
firstPlayerRule: The tallest person takes the Referee Advisor card and makes the first contract offer or passes.
clarifications: The rules call the people playing managers, to distinguish them from the basketball player cards.
Taking the Referee during setup also requires returning $2m to the supply.
